title: Commitment
description: An obligation the owner made, to themselves or to another person. The outbound half of the owner's first priority — zero broken promises; the inbound mirror is waiting-on. Child tasks are no longer embedded here: tasks are first-class records in _data/tasks/ that point back with commitment_id, because per ADR-008 an entity that can exist without a parent cannot be stored inside one.

project_id.description: Project this commitment belongs to, or null when it stands alone. Parentless commitments are visible through the unfiled view.

promised_to.description: Person ID if the identity is confirmed, otherwise the name as written; null for a self-commitment. Protected: an agent never invents who a promise was made to.

due_date.description: Protected: an agent never invents a deadline.

completed.description: Protected: an agent never invents completion of anything.
